comments.body:
Installed Sepo infrastructure for `lm4sci/lm4sci.github.io`.

- PR: https://github.com/lm4sci/lm4sci.github.io/pull/3
- Source: `self-evolving/repo` `v0.2.0` at `810dfcaf206c03a805f4b3d072bf50900fe0d3ed`
- Release: https://github.com/self-evolving/repo/releases/tag/v0.2.0
- Note: no stable release was available, so I used the latest non-draft prerelease.

Validation: target resolved cleanly, fork worktree prepared, no `.github` path conflicts found, target `.github/workflows/nextjs.yml` preserved, `.agent/dist/` and `.agent/node_modules/` excluded, staged install diff committed and published.

Required setup after merge:
1. Install the Sepo GitHub App, or choose another supported auth path.
2. Add `OPENAI_API_KEY` and/or `CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN`.
3. Run **Actions > Agent / Onboarding / Check Setup**.
4. Review the `Sepo setup check` issue.
5. Initialize `agent/memory` if missing.
6. Optionally initialize `agent/rubrics`.
